classification: FIXED HISTORICAL RISK DIAGNOSTIC, NOT STOP_OPTIMIZATION, NO NEW OOS EDGE
goal: For each of 47 unmodified Bybit Spot BTCUSDT MR40 LONG positions, identify when adverse price extremes (relative to pre-existing entry open) first occur. Quantify separate early-vs-middle-vs-late risk without confusing longer exposure with causality, and without adding a stop to the strategy.

source.entry: after confirmed MR40 entry signal in following 4h candle OPEN, not filled market order
source.exit: following 4h OPEN after natural MR40 exit signal; never use exit-bar H/L
source.venue: Bybit BTCUSDT Spot only, no other exchange source

fixed_diagnostic.absolute_low_MAE: max(0,100*(1-lowest_held_4h_bar_low/entry_next_open_price)) measured from entry, NOT global account max DD
fixed_diagnostic.bar_assignment: For each held full 4h bar compute offset=4*(bar_index-entry_index). Assign into one and only one of the three fixed bands. Bars of EXIT OPEN are forbidden. Intrabar low instant lies somewhere after bar open and before its close.
fixed_diagnostic.time_to_first_threshold: First bar with OHLC LOW <= entry_open_price*(1-threshold/100); record bar opening offset hours, not actual time or fill at that price.
fixed_diagnostic.denominators: For each band include n_exposed positions (>=1 held candle in that band), n_total_positions (47) and n_threshold_crossers, to avoid falsely comparing different time-at-risk denominators.
fixed_diagnostic.risk_event_precedence: Report first 5/10/15% adverse candle band; if no threshold event, report null. If early crossing and later worse low, retain both facts separately.
fixed_diagnostic.quantiles: No quantiles/hypothesis tests for this step, to avoid discovery-led rule selection.
fixed_diagnostic.aggregate_by_window: all47, train25 and eval22 separate, no train/eval label leakage or tuned thresholds
fixed_diagnostic.reconciliation: For each of 47 historical pair identities, recompute full held low, held bars and worst-entry-relative price_MAE; these MUST match previous SHA-pinned complete risk report to 1e-18 in percent before output.
fixed_diagnostic.disallowed: No stop fills, no hypothetical profit improvement, no automatic time stop, no risk budget invented, no promote.
